record.body:
## Description

Make close-batch resolve check_run_id and red_check_run_id from the artifact store and refuse on missing or mismatched criterion_id, runner, result, or revision. Restore tdd revision-without-red refusal and missing id/result as request errors. Cover close-side real_gap mutants (fabricated ids, dirty green vs SHA red, missing green revision).

## Approach

1. Add failing tests in tests/test_close_batch.py: fabricated check_run_id/red_check_run_id that would previously close; store exists but copied result/revision disagrees; tdd entry with revision and no red fields; missing check_run_id; missing result; red SHA + dirty green; valid red but omitted green revision.
2. In affidavit/close_batch.py, before building the apply batch, load each referenced check-run via adaptive-artifacts get (same discovery as aff check; honor --cwd for code HEAD, store on primary).
3. Compare store fields to the request; mismatch or missing → CloseRefused / CloseRequestError with no batch written.
4. Run existing red-first ancestry using store-backed revisions, not unchecked copies.
5. Keep NDJSON apply-batch shape; do not write check-runs for tdd/check from close-batch.
record.subject: close-batch-store-verify
